assets.subject: Owner-accepted S1-01 look: compact premium sculpted 3D CARTOON educational miniature on warm off-white, plausible rural field-store, matte route surface, wood, metal, blank card and earth materials, clean silhouette, soft studio contact shadows, blank margins for later four-language overlays. LOW ROUTE-LEVEL THREE-QUARTER view, not an overhead map. A modest field-store model is at left and a fenced hazard zone far BEHIND it. A wide clean path from the store reaches a neutral junction OUTSIDE the hazard boundary; beyond the junction are TWO separate blank destination props at safe distance: an open assembly-board plinth and a closed shelter structure. They are alternative destinations subject to the actual hazard/site plan, never both automatically appropriate. At the junction a blank removable attendance-token rack has one empty slot among several plain tokens, and an empty coordinator call-point prop nearby. There is no person and no suggestion to re-enter the fenced zone to find the missing token. Preserve an obvious safe route that never crosses the hazard fence. No simulated chemical cloud, wildfire, lightning, live incident, or universal outdoor-muster claim. No printed words, numbers, arrows, pseudo-writing, school, Spark, brand, logo or watermark. The selected route/destination and missing-person action will be explained only in separately editable four-language text and audio. Compositionally different from a future elevated whole-site still.

One premium compact sculpted 3D CARTOON educational four-pod teaching board on warm off-white matching Masaarat S1-01; realistic but simplified dry plastic, cloth, soil and metal materials, soft contact shadows, generous empty gutters so each pod can be separately cropped for four worked-case narration. Four PHYSICALLY SEPARATE low isometric prop islands only, no written labels or quadrant gridlines. POD ONE: a closed blank training bottle beside an UNUSED clean eyewash station and blank SDS holder, representing the chemical-splash case context without depicting an exposed body or actual chemical. POD TWO: empty shade canopy, drinking-water vessel and cooling cloth, representing a heat-symptom case without a patient and without suggesting water for a confused person. POD THREE: a small SHALLOW ground irregularity with a visible physical safety boundary, empty first-aid kit and blank call-card holder, representing the hidden ankle hazard with no casualty or movement. POD FOUR: an unknown-air boundary screened behind a solid barrier, with a separate clean route away, representing withdrawal from an unverified release without visible vapor or approach. No people, body parts, hands, medical treatment, active spill, real toxin, hazardous rescue, emergency call in progress, words, numbers, arrows, pseudo-writing, school/Spark branding, logos or watermarks. Keep all props distinct and scientifically neutral; the case facts and corrected actions are editable overlays and spoken script, not baked into pixels.
